already_seen_disclosure: Both cohorts' outcomes have been examined by reviewers already; all real-data results are already-seen and exploratory, not confirmatory.

r16_rule.id: R-16 pEMT tumour bordered by fibroblasts (UPMC)
r16_rule.direction: higher is worse: hazard ratio > 1; a top rank with HR < 1 counts as not rediscovered
r16_rule.pEMT_proxy: Podoplanin-positive tumour cells (UPMC type 'Tumor (Podo+)'). Podoplanin is a pEMT-programme gene in HNSCC. Slug is not in the UPMC panel. Vimentin is, but the grammar has no marker-gated focal type, so Vimentin+ tumour is not a candidate column
r16_rule.fibroblast_proxy: UPMC type 'Stromal / Fibroblast'. aSMA is a marker, not a type, so it stays out of the primary candidate
deviations: The plan's 26 um becomes 25 um, the nearest grammar radius
The plan's '>30% fibroblasts' threshold becomes the continuous fraction the screen tests

modal.data: upmc_labels.csv from Modal volume preflight-data; upmc_raw_data.zip from Zenodo 13179600
